decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Medicham to Fake Out one TR setter and smash Dark/Steel and Rock with Close Combat; pair with Choice Scarf Corviknight to Iron Head the other TR setter and pivot with U-turn. Back Archaludon for Stamina walling and Light Screen support, and Aegislash for Fairy resistance, King's Shield pivot, and Shadow Ball/Flash Cannon coverage against Gardevoir/Hatterene.
decisions.notebook: Team build: Mega Medicham @ Medichamite Jolly; Archaludon @ Leftovers Bold Stamina; Aegislash @ Focus Sash Calm Stance Change; Corviknight @ Choice Scarf Jolly Mirror Armor; Pelipper @ Damp Rock Timid Drizzle; Stunfisk-Galar @ Shuca Berry Sassy Mimicry. Plan: Medicham mega-evolves turn 1 for Pure Power physical sweep. Archaludon walls physical attackers (Kingambit/Arcanine) and sets Light Screen. Aegislash pivots with King's Shield and hits Fairy/Psychic with Shadow Ball/Flash Cannon. Corviknight outspeeds and pressures with Iron Head/Brave Bird/U-turn. Pelipper sets rain for Hurricane and Wide Guard vs spread (Rock Slide/Dazzling Gleam/Hyper Voice). Stunfisk sets Stealth Rock and Thunder Wave but Earthquake hits allies. Opponent likely leads Farigiraf + Hatterene for Trick Room; Fake Out + Iron Head aims to stop both. Under TR, slower backline (Aegislash/Archaludon) functions better than fast leads.

decisions.rationale: Standard Trick Room lead: Farigiraf+Hatterene set TR with Armor Tail blocking Fake Out and Magic Bounce deterring status. Kingambit is the primary TR sweeper; Arcanine-Hisui provides Intimidate support, Rock Slide spread, and Close Combat for Archaludon. Focus Sash offsets 4x Ground weakness vs Stunfisk-Galar. Mirror Armor Corviknight is a risk but Arcanine can be timed around it.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Medicham-Mega/Archaludon/Aegislash/Corviknight-Scarf/Pelipper-Drizzle/Stunfisk-Galar. Dual-mode: TR primary. Threats: Corviknight Mirror Armor reflects Intimidate back onto H-Arcanine. Pelipper Wide Guard blocks Dazzling Gleam/Rock Slide/Hyper Voice. Stunfisk-Galar slow (46-75) threatens under TR with Earthquake (H-Arcanine 4x weak). Archaludon Flash Cannon can OHKO roll Hatterene (62.8-113.6%). Medicham-Mega CC does 30-52% to Farigiraf. H-Arcanine must avoid Corviknight on field when switching in. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave bypasses accuracy checks.

decisions.rationale: Lead with Medicham Fake Out on Farigiraf (priority +3) to flinch and block its Trick Room, while mega-evolving for Pure Power. Corviknight Choice Scarf outspeeds both foes and hits Hatterene with super-effective Iron Head (Steel2x vs Fairy/Psychic) before its priority -7 Trick Room can fire. This aims to KO or severely damage Hatterene and deny the opponent's TR setup on turn1.

reflections.summary: Lost because the preview (Mega Medicham, Archaludon, Aegislash, Choice-Scarf Corviknight) collapsed into a solo Archaludon facing healthy Kingambit (+2 Atk via Defiant) and Focus-Sash Arcanine-Hisui; Corviknight was Choice-locked into Iron Head and died to Kowtow Cleave, Aegislash and Medicham fell early, leaving no switch-ins. Archaludon’s Protect/Stamina stall eventually broke against dual super-effective physical hits.
reflections.adjustment: Drop Corviknight and do not Mega-evolve Medicham in this preview; replace them with bulkier checks/pivots that survive Kingambit Kowtow Cleave and Arcanine Close Combat so Archaludon is never left alone against the physical duo.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs Trick Room pair Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Armor Tail) and Hatterene (Life Orb, Magic Bounce), then physical core Kingambit (Black Glasses, Defiant, Kowtow Cleave/Sucker Punch—Intimidate triggers +2 Atk) and Arcanine-Hisui (Focus Sash, Intimidate, Close Combat/Flare Blitz). Avoid Choice-lock and frail Focus-Sash users in preview; Mega Medicham was eliminated without impacting the core. Prioritize defensive pivots over all-offense against this physical duo.

reflections.adjustment: Next game, anticipate Pelipper rain weakening Arcanine's Fire moves and enabling Hurricane; consider leading Farigiraf + Arcanine to set Trick Room and threaten Pelipper with Rock Slide, or preserve Kingambit for a late-game Trick Room sweep.
